title: Which waiting questions the owner's answers or confirmed records already settle

questions.description: One entry for each waiting question that an answer, a confirmed record or a later request settles, or that repeats another; nothing for the others.

answer.description: The id of the owner's answer that settles it.

record.description: Or the id of the confirmed record that settles it.

quote.description: The words of that answer, record or later request that settle it, copied exactly and contiguous.

other.description: Or the id of another waiting question that asks exactly the same.

replaced.description: Or true when a later request of the person (quote its words) replaces this question.

settlements.description: One entry for each waiting stale-link question a confirmed decision settles by refreshing its link or rewording its requirement.

decision.description: The id of the confirmed record that settles it.

quote.description: The words of that record that settle it, copied exactly.

record.description: reword, for a question without a link: the id of the confirmed record the decision contradicts, one the question is about.

wording.description: reword: the statement the requirement should now read.
